title: At least 930 people have died in Congo’s Ebola outbreak - NBC News
snippet: # At least 930 people have died in Congo’s Ebola outbreak. The Ebola outbreak that was declared in eastern Congo on May 15 is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. A healthcare worker takes samples from a patient suffering from Ebola virus disease in Bunia, Ituri, in the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo, in June.Benediction Murhabazi / AFP via Getty Images. BUNIA, Congo — At least 930 people have died in Congo’s Ebola outbreak, the country’s Ministry of Health said Monday, with 37 new deaths recorded in a 24-hour span Friday into Saturday, one of the highest totals. The Bundibugyo virus responsible for the outbreak is less common than others that cause Ebola disease, and there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Congo’s Health Ministry said in its latest update that 724 patients are currently in isolation and in hospitals, and that it is intensifying response efforts in affected health zones.

title: At least 930 people have died in Congo’s Ebola outbreak - AP News
snippet: # At least 930 people have died in Congo’s Ebola outbreak. Health workers tend to an Ebola patient at the Rwampara Treatment Center in Ituri, Congo, Thursday, June 18, 2026. Health workers involved in Congo’s Ebola response go on strike as they protest over payment issues in Bunia, Congo, Wednesday, July 15, 2026. A police officer removes rubble as health workers involved in Congo’s Ebola response go on strike to protest over payment issues in Bunia, Congo, Wednesday, July 15, 2026. BUNIA, Congo (AP) — At least 930 people have died in Congo’s Ebola outbreak, the country’s Ministry of Health said. The deaths were recorded out of the 2,344 cases confirmed as of Saturday, the health ministry said overnight into Monday. The Ebola outbreak that was declared in eastern Congo on May 15 is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. At least 12 attacks have been recorded against health facilities and teams since the outbreak was declared in mid-May, authorities said on Saturday.
